title: Wilbert Smith's secret role running radio monitoring in Ottawa
summary: Grant Cameron tells of Wilbert Smith's secret role running radio monitoring in Ottawa, about 1950s at Ottawa, Canada, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He said, "He had a super top security clearance. He ran radio Ottawa."

plain: Grant Cameron, a UFO researcher, tells podcast host Jesse Michels what a man named Art Bridge told him about Wilbert Smith, a Canadian who worked in Ottawa in the 1950s. According to Bridge, Smith had a very high security clearance and ran radio monitoring in Ottawa, which would make Smith a real government insider rather than an outsider.
